description: Java source code for the class TbRenameKeysNode, which is a rule engine component that renames message or message metadata keys based on a provided mapping. It is part of the Thingsboard rule engine transformation components.

classes.name: TbRenameKeysNode
classes.description: A rule engine transformation node that renames keys in message or message metadata according to a specified mapping.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the node with configuration, setting the source of keys to rename and the mapping of old to new keys.

methods.name: onMsg
methods.description: Processes incoming messages, renaming keys in metadata or data based on configuration.

methods.name: getNewKeyForUpgradeFromVersionZero
methods.description: Returns the key 'renameIn' for upgrade purposes from version zero.

methods.name: getKeyToUpgradeFromVersionOne
methods.description: Returns the property name for upgrade from version one.
